title: Central forces and the Kepler problem
summary: Reduction of the two-body problem; angular momentum and the effective potential; the orbit equation and conic sections; Kepler's laws, including the third law from scaling symmetry; precession; scattering and the Rutherford cross-section.

objectives.description: Objectives will be finalised when the unit is prepared; the source material is Tong, Dynamics and Relativity, Chapter 4, Tong, Classical Dynamics, Section 2.5 (two-body problem), and the scaling-symmetry passage of the 8.09 Chapter 1 notes (PDF page 14).

preparation.description: Read Tong, Dynamics and Relativity, Chapter 4 Central Forces (reference-only; read on the author's page).
Read Tong, Classical Dynamics, Section 2.5 Applications, in particular 2.5.4 Two Body Problem (reference-only).
Re-read the scaling-symmetry item in Section 1.3 of the 8.09 Chapter 1 notes (PDF page 14), which obtains Kepler's third law from the homogeneity of the potential.
